reason: I already have a bottle that works, and Claro is a brand-new name with no reviews I can check. A creator plug isn't proof, and I'm not putting $68 plus a subscription on something nobody has tested.
objection: There are no independent reviews and no lab results showing what the filter actually removes. All I have is the supplier's 150 L rating and a creator getting paid to show it to me.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews plus third-party test results (an NSF-type certification) showing what the filter removes from tap water.
